correctness.rationale: For c=a+ib, |1+iy-cy²|²-1=y²[(a²+b²)y²-2by+1-2a]. Convexity means two endpoint checks are necessary and sufficient. Each endpoint gives a closed coefficient disk with squared center distance minus squared radii sum equal ((R+S)²-4)/(R²S²). Thus existence iff R+S<=2; external tangency gives unique c at equality. Independent SymPy verified expansion, distance, and strict-interior factorization, including asymmetry. The corollary correctly restricts operator norm to normal matrices with both extrema present.
residual_risks: First-order only; no nonlinear/nonnormal stability claim.
